name: snn.shadow

description.en: W-SNN (operator 2026-10-06: sheaf neural networks now, built honestly). A cellular-sheaf neural network (stalk dim 8, two Neural-Sheaf-Diffusion layers over dish-category/tag/ingredient groups, learned diagonal restriction maps, a learned per-axis residual cosine) ranks a guest's dishes from what the server profile already holds (sense vector, category and tag weights). Trained offline in floats (scratchpad snn-train/train.py), inferred in Q16 INTEGERS (crates/dowiz-hub/src/snn), bit-identical to a python-int reference on 60/60 golden cases, weights one 1712-byte blob with a zlib crc32 (refused by name when wrong; the current ranker keeps serving). SHADOW by default: when a guest with a server profile (and no objection) opens their order page, GET /api/order/:id/taste runs the network beside the current server ranker (block::taste top-k cosine) and adds ONE per-venue aggregate (comparisons, first-dish agreement, top-3 overlap, unusable count, model id) to the venue's own image 'snn' -- no guest key, no dish list. The page's bytes do not change. Switch per venue: settings key snn = shadow|on|off (default shadow); off loads and runs nothing; on is for after the A/B shows a win (nothing shows either list until the server 'For you' lands). Never a price, a discount or an eligibility. 1.1.0 (operator 2026-10-06, quality): the order-page read also HOLDS both top-3s (current server ranker, network) in the guest's server profile (`snn_held`; only beside a profile that exists, so an objecting guest stores nothing; removed with the profile on forget-me or objection); at that guest's next order the hold is checked against the dishes ordered, counted per venue (settled, currentHitPm, snnHitPm) and cleared. 1.2.0 (main's Art. 15 decision 2026-10-06): the guest's own export GET /api/order/:id/taste lists the hold under taste.held (both top-3s by id and name, temporary: true, deletedAt: next_order) while it is held; the order page's taste strip is untouched, and the export with taste.held removed is byte-identical between shadow and off.
description.uk: Нейромережа пучків ранжує страви для гостя в тіні: рахує поруч із нинішнім ранжуванням, гостю нічого не змінює, власник бачить лише відсоток збігу по закладу; перемикач тінь/увімк./вимк., за замовчуванням тінь. 1.1.0: якість — два топ-3 тримаються в профілі гостя до його наступного замовлення, потім рахується по закладу, чи замовлена страва потрапила в кожен топ-3, і утримане стирається; гість, що заперечив, не зберігає нічого. 1.2.0: експорт гостя («що ми зберігаємо») показує утримані топ-3 як тимчасову перевірку, що стирається при наступному замовленні.

producer.what: rank(): the network's top-k (score > 0, ties by id bytes)
decode(): the weight blob, crc first, refused by name
decide(): what is shown per mode; off never calls the network
compare(): current server ranker vs the network
observe(): mode, catalogue, compare, count (never fails the page)
guest_view calls observe after the objection check
after(): settle the hold inside the profile write, then count it
Held / settle: one check per hold, cleared

consumer.what: mountSnn(): More -> Customers, the shadow line and the three-way switch
the customers sheet mounts it under the segments
heldLine(): the export's held top-3s, by name, in the guest's 'what we store'

probe: node tools/live-proof/probes/snn.mjs (main runs it on qa-durres after deploy; SNN_WRITE=1 also flips the switch off and back to shadow)

export_schema.description: GET /api/order/:id/taste -> taste.held, present only while a hold exists
